G5207.d: a son; in the ordinary sense; as belonging to, being connected with or having the quality of that which follows; a man
s: The book of the generation of Jesus Christ, the «son» of David, the son of Abraham.
Blessed are the peacemakers: for they shall be called the «children» of God.
And he said, A certain man had two «sons»:

G5259.d: under; of motion; Of position; under, subject to; Of time, about; In composition; subjection; secrecy; diminution
s: All things are lawful unto me, but all things are not expedient: all things are lawful for me, but I will not be brought «under» the power of any.
And there were dwelling at Jerusalem Jews, devout men, out of every nation «under» heaven.
Howbeit Jesus spake of his death: but they thought that he had spoken of taking of rest in «sleep».

G5263.d: to show by tracing out; hence, generally, to teach, make known
s: Then said he to the multitude that came forth to be baptized of him, O generation of vipers, who hath «warned» you to flee from the wrath to come?
For I will «shew» him how great things he must suffer for my name’s sake.
And Peter answered him and said, Lord, if it be thou, bid me come unto thee on the «water».

G5266.d: a sole bound under the foot, a sandal
s: Carry neither purse, nor scrip, nor «shoes»: and salute no man by the way.

G5217.d: to go slowly away, withdraw oneself, depart
s: Take that thine is, and «go» thy way: I will give unto this last, even as unto thee.
And the beast that was, and is not, even he is the eighth, and is of the seven, and «goeth» into perdition.
Then saith Jesus unto him, «Get» thee hence, Satan: for it is written, Thou shalt worship the Lord thy God, and him only shalt thou serve.
The «officers» answered, Never man spake like this man.
But Peter followed him afar off unto the high priest’s palace, and went in, and sat with the «servants», to see the end.
And when they were at Salamis, they preached the word of God in the synagogues of the Jews: and they had also John to their «minister».
Heaven is my throne, and earth is my «footstool»: what house will ye build me? saith the Lord: or what is the place of my rest?

G5228.d: over, above, across, beyond; for, on behalf of; for, because of, for the sake of; for, instead of, in the name of; for, concerning, with regard to; over, beyond, across; above, beyond, over, more than; than; more; I more; In composition; over; beyond; on behalf of
s: The disciple is not «above» his master, nor the servant above his lord.
For unto you it is given in the «behalf» of Christ, not only to believe on him, but also to suffer for his sake;
Having confidence in thy obedience I wrote unto thee, knowing that thou wilt also do «more» than I say.
Ye «hypocrites», well did Esaias prophesy of you, saying,

G5219.d: to listen, attend, hence; to answer a knock at a door; to attend to, submit to, obey
s: Children, «obey» your parents in the Lord: for this is right.
Servants, be «obedient» to them that are your masters according to the flesh, with fear and trembling, in singleness of your heart, as unto Christ;
And as he was now going down, his servants «met» him, and told him, saying, Thy son liveth.
Then shall the kingdom of heaven be likened unto ten virgins, which took their lamps, and went forth to «meet» the bridegroom.

G5278.d: to stay behind; to await, wait for; of things, to bear patiently, endure
s: But he that shall «endure» unto the end, the same shall be saved.

G5225.d: to be in existence, be ready, be at hand; to be, prop, expressing continuance of an antecedent state or condition; to belong to; one's belongings, possessions
s: When a strong man armed keepeth his palace, his «goods» are in peace:
And she answered and said unto him, Yes, Lord: yet the dogs «under» the table eat of the children’s crumbs.
Speaking lies in «hypocrisy»; having their conscience seared with a hot iron;

G5214.d: to sing to, laud, sing to the praise of; to sing
s: And when they had «sung» an «hymn», they went out into the mount of Olives.
But be «shod» with sandals; and not put on two coats.
Thefts, covetousness, wickedness, deceit, lasciviousness, an evil eye, blasphemy, «pride», foolishness:

G5276.d: τό (ὑπό, ληνός), a vessel or trough beneath a winepress to receive the juice (RV, a pit for the winepress): (see Swete, in l, and cf. ληνός).† (AS)
s: And he began to speak unto them by parables. A certain man planted a vineyard, and set an hedge about it, and digged a place for the «winefat», and built a tower, and let it out to husbandmen, and went into a far country.

G5244.d: showing oneself above others; arrogant, haughty, disdainful
s: He hath shewed strength with his arm; he hath scattered the «proud» in the imagination of their hearts.
And Mary abode with her about three months, and «returned» to her own house.
And when they found him not, they «turned» «back» again to Jerusalem, seeking him.

G5293.d: to subject, put in subjection; to subject oneself, obey
s: Wherefore ye must needs be «subject», not only for wrath, but also for conscience sake.
Wives, «submit» yourselves unto your own husbands, as unto the Lord.
And hath «put» all things under his feet, and gave him to be the head over all things to the church,
And he «withdrew» himself into the wilderness, and prayed.

Give, and it shall be given unto you; good measure, pressed down, and shaken together, and «running» «over», shall men give into your bosom. For with the same measure that ye mete withal it shall be measured to you again.

G5274.d: to take or bear up; to receive, welcome, entertain; to catch up in speech; Of mental action, to assume, suppose
s: And when he had spoken these things, while they beheld, he was taken up; and a cloud «received» him out of their sight.
In your «patience» possess ye your souls.

G5264.d: to receive under one's roof, receive as a guest, entertain hospitably
s: And he made haste, and came down, and «received» him joyfully.
And, behold, there was a certain man before him which had the «dropsy».

G5299.d: to strike under the eye, give a black eye; to repress

G5291.d: late form of ὑπο-στορέννυμι, to spread or strew under: with accusative of thing(s),.† (AS)
s: And as he went, they «spread» their clothes in the way.

And they watched him, and sent forth spies, which should «feign» themselves just men, that they might take hold of his words, that so they might deliver him unto the power and authority of the governor.

G5279.d: to cause one to remember, put one in mind or remind one of
s: «Put» them in mind to be subject to principalities and powers, to obey magistrates, to be ready to every good work,
For if they do these things in a «green» tree, what shall be done in the dry?

G5201.d: a water-pot; jar; a pot, urn or jar
s: And there were set there six «waterpots» of stone, after the manner of the purifying of the Jews, containing two or three firkins apiece.
For I have given you an «example», that ye should do as I have done to you.

G5253.d: In LXX and NT, an upper chamber, roof-chamber, built on the flat roof of the house
s: And there were many lights in the «upper» chamber, where they were gathered together.

G5223.d: -εως, ἡ (ὑπάρχω), 1. subsistence, existence (Arist., al.). 2. In late writers, = τὰ ὑπάρχοντα, substance, property: pl.,.† (AS)
s: And sold their possessions and «goods», and parted them to all men, as every man had need.

G5260.d: to subject, submit; to suggest, whisper, prompt; instigate
s: Then they «suborned» men, which said, We have heard him speak blasphemous words against Moses, and against God.
For to this end also did I write, that I might know the proof of you, whether ye be «obedient» in all things.
Against whom when the accusers stood up, they brought none accusation of such things as I «supposed»:
For David, after he had «served» his own generation by the will of God, fell on sleep, and was laid unto his fathers, and saw corruption:
And he prayed again, and the heaven gave «rain», and the earth brought forth her fruit.

G5288.d: to draw back, withdraw; to shrink or draw back
s: Now the just shall live by faith: but if any man draw «back», my soul shall have no pleasure in him.

G5284.d: to sail under, i.e. under the lee of: with accusative, 7.† (AS)
s: And when we had launched from thence, we «sailed» «under» Cyprus, because the winds were contrary.

G5295.d: to run in under; of navigators, to run in the lee of
s: And «running» «under» a certain island which is called Clauda, we had much work to come by the boat:

G5269.d: to undergird; to undergird or frap
s: Which when they had taken up, they used helps, «undergirding» the ship; and, fearing lest they should fall into the quicksands, strake sail, and so were driven.

G5218.d: obedience; Of obedience to God's commands; Of Christ's obedience
s: And having in a readiness to revenge all disobedience, when your «obedience» is fulfilled.
Now we know that what things soever the law saith, it saith to them who are under the law: that every mouth may be stopped, and all the world may become «guilty» before God.
Moreover the law entered, that the offence might abound. But where sin abounded, grace did «much» more abound:

G5220.d: under or subject to a man, married

s: Was then that which is good made death unto me? God forbid. But sin, that it might appear sin, working death in me by that which is good; that sin by the commandment might become «exceeding» sinful.
Having predestinated us unto the «adoption» of children by Jesus Christ to himself, according to the good pleasure of his will,

G5241.d: to intercede or make petition for
s: Likewise the Spirit also helpeth our infirmities: for we know not what we should pray for as we ought: but the Spirit itself «maketh» «intercession» for us with groanings which cannot be uttered.
Nay, in all these things we are «more» «than» «conquerors» through him that loved us.
Lord, they have killed thy prophets, and digged down thine altars; and I am «left» alone, and they seek my life.

For I say, through the grace given unto me, to every man that is among you, not to think of himself more «highly» than he ought to think; but to think soberly, according as God hath dealt to every man the measure of faith.

Yea doubtless, and I count all things but loss for the «excellency» of the knowledge of Christ Jesus my Lord: for whom I have suffered the loss of all things, and do count them but dung, that I may win Christ,

G5294.d: to risk one's life; to suggest
s: Who have for my life «laid» «down» their own necks: unto whom not only I give thanks, but also all the churches of the Gentiles.
And I, brethren, when I came to you, came not with «excellency» of speech or of wisdom, declaring unto you the testimony of God.
But if any man think that he behaveth himself uncomely toward his virgin, if she pass the flower of her «age», and need so require, let him do what he will, he sinneth not: let them marry.
Persecutions, afflictions, which came unto me at Antioch, at Iconium, at Lystra; what persecutions I «endured»: but out of them all the Lord delivered me.
And by their prayer for you, which long after you for the «exceeding» grace of God in you.
For we are made partakers of Christ, if we hold the beginning of our «confidence» stedfast unto the end;
Let the woman learn in silence with all «subjection».
To preach the gospel in the regions «beyond» you, and not to boast in another man’s line of things made ready to our hand.
Are they ministers of Christ? (I speak as a fool) I am more; in labours more abundant, in stripes «above» «measure», in prisons more frequent, in deaths oft.
Who opposeth and «exalteth» «himself» above all that is called God, or that is worshipped; so that he as God sitteth in the temple of God, shewing himself that he is God.
He that descended is the same also that ascended up far «above» all heavens, that he might fill all things.)

G5215.d: a hymn; in LXX and NT a song of praise addressed to God
s: Speaking to yourselves in psalms and «hymns» and spiritual songs, singing and making melody in your heart to the Lord;

G5251.d: to exalt beyond measure, exalt to the highest place
s: Wherefore God also hath «highly» «exalted» him, and given him a name which is above every name:
Blotting out the handwriting of ordinances that was against us, which was «contrary» to us, and took it out of the way, nailing it to his cross;
That no man «go» «beyond» and defraud his brother in any matter: because that the Lord is the avenger of all such, as we also have forewarned you and testified.
We are bound to thank God always for you, brethren, as it is meet, because that your faith groweth «exceedingly», and the charity of every one of you all toward each other aboundeth;
Howbeit for this cause I obtained mercy, that in me first Jesus Christ might shew forth all longsuffering, for a «pattern» to them which should hereafter believe on him to life everlasting.
And their word will eat as doth a canker: of whom is «Hymenaeus» and Philetus;

G5202.d: -ῶ (ὕδωρ, πίνω), to drink water, opposite to οἴνῳ χρῆσθαι: (Hdt., i, 71; Plat., Rep., 561 with, al.).† (AS)
s: «Drink» no longer «water», but use a little wine for thy stomach’s sake and thine often infirmities.
He is proud, knowing nothing, but doting about questions and strifes of words, whereof cometh envy, strife, railings, evil «surmisings»,
This second epistle, beloved, I now write unto you; in both which I stir up your pure minds by way of «remembrance»:
But we are not of them who «draw» «back» unto perdition; but of them that believe to the saving of the soul.

Obey them that have the rule over you, and «submit» yourselves: for they watch for your souls, as they that must give account, that they may do it with joy, and not with grief: for that is unprofitable for you.
For even hereunto were ye called: because Christ also suffered for us, «leaving» us an example, that ye should follow his steps:
For even hereunto were ye called: because Christ also suffered for us, leaving us an «example», that ye should follow his steps:
These are murmurers, complainers, walking after their own lusts; and their mouth speaketh «great» «swelling» «words», having men’s persons in admiration because of advantage.

Even as Sodom and Gomorrha, and the cities about them in like manner, giving themselves over to fornication, and going after strange flesh, are set forth for an example, «suffering» the vengeance of eternal fire.
